thread:
Marina (Partnerships): Heads up - AcmeEdge wants to include per-seat adjustments in the marketplace usage webhook so they can prorate mid-billing-cycle. They prefer one webhook instead of a separate adjustments feed. Risk: potential double-billing. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sam (Integrations Eng): We currently only accept usage_units + sku_id. Adding seat_snapshot/seat_delta is doable but need clear semantics and idempotency guarantees.

Nina (Billing): Ledger expects a stable entitlement per invoice epoch. If partners push seat changes in the usage stream we must enforce an entitlement_sequence or similar to keep writes idempotent.

Jordan (Partner Success): AcmeEdge can emit an entitlement_sequence and idempotency_key. They asked for a sample payload and to avoid two separate calls.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Proposed minimal schema fields: seat_snapshot (absolute int), entitlement_sequence (monotonic int), idempotency_key. Keep usage_units unchanged for metering. We'll ack with last_applied_sequence.

Nina (Billing): That works. Billing will compute prorate adjustments = (days_remaining / days_in_cycle) * price_per_seat, emit cents-level line items, and use banker's rounding. Need decision: apply adjustment to current open invoice or next invoice if past cutoff.

Alex (SRE): Add rate-limits for entitlement events and a replay endpoint for partners to backfill missed sequences. Also instrument metric partner.entitlement.sequence.skew.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Draft webhook v2 payload example:
{"event_id":"evt-01","event_ts":"2026-03-20T12:34:56Z","customer_id":"cust-123","sku_id":"acme-seats","usage_units":1200,"seat_snapshot":42,"entitlement_sequence":17,"idempotency_key":"acme-20260320-17"}
We'll return an ack: {"status":"ok","last_applied_sequence":17}.

Jordan (Partner Success): I'll confirm with AcmeEdge PM they can emit sequence and handle replays. They want credits reflected immediately to avoid customer confusion.

Nina (Billing): Action items: RFC for entitlement_sequence support, implement prorate calc + rounding policy, and set invoice-window cutoff. I'll loop in Legal for credit/refund language.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Action items: publish webhook schema v2, implement ack and replay endpoints, add test harness. I'll open PRs and staging tests.

Alex (SRE): I'll add dashboards and a small runbook for out-of-order entitlement handling.

billing-bot: Created ticket INV-3421 "Entitlement sequence + prorate support" and linked this thread. :white_check_mark:

Marina (Partnerships): Goal: partner beta by end of next sprint to align with AcmeEdge announcement. I'll coordinate weekly until schema stable. :thumbsup:
